object.description: Produce a PDF with a stand-in PDF program, once finishing and once not finishing within its limit. Expected: the program is run with a 300 s limit, no console window and no input; when the limit passes, the export ends with an error saying the PDF program didn't finish within 300 s, and the program isn't run again.
